conf.description: Facility SNMP UPS-MIB/PowerNet-MIB/Liebert-GP trap direct route: decode already-varbind-named fields into ECS, per recommendations.direct.cribl (no vendor pack installed on this instance, so OID-name resolution is NOT performed - see README gap)

conf.comment: RFC1628 UPS-MIB + APC PowerNet-MIB + Vertiv/Liebert LIEBERT-GP-* trap events. Assumes the Cribl SNMP Trap source has already resolved varbinds to the MIB object names used as this work order's 'vendor' field names. No Cribl Trap Varbind Translation pack is installed on this instance, so AutonomousType/OID-valued fields (snmpTrapOID, upsAlarmDescr) are NOT resolved to notification/alarm names here - passed through raw.

functions.description: Pipeline purpose, input-field assumption, and known OID-resolution gap

Computed fields read from ORIGINAL vendor names before rename: battery-status enum decode + derived severity (chosen linear scale, see README), v1 agent-addr fallback for observer.ip, APC TimeTicks-to-minutes fold onto the standard-MIB runtime field (recommendations.direct.cribl), and a v1/v2c-cleartext-community boolean instead of carrying the community string itself
Batch rename of the direct 1:1 fields, including the two OID-valued fields passed through raw (event.code, event.action - see gap)

event.dataset (no hyphen), event.provider so poll-sourced records never double-count against a trap, and cleanup of consumed originals - agent-addr removed via the 'agent-*' glob since the literal hyphenated name is rejected by eval.remove; community dropped entirely, never indexed
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
